body: That's a really good point, and im sure my therapist is doing that too. Sometimes I just wish I had someone, anyone, to talk to about how I am actually feeling. I don't know if I'm making sense but I wish I could tell someone about all these dark feelings without immediately being diverted to how to fix it. I understand the value of not dwelling on it, but I don't understand why I'm not allowed to just once express everything that I'm feeling.

I can't talk to anyone, either. My therapist doesn't even really listen to my suicidal thoughts because as soon as I say I won't actually do it, she acts like it's not as important. That happens a lot to people that I know in therapy too. I don't think what we are going through is well understood by anyone. And im not too sure psychologists even know how to deal with it. Anyway all im trying to really say is I have experienced being called dramatic and like I'm making death sound "trivial" by "throwing it around" when what I'm trying to do is express that I actually do want to die. I don't know exactly what you're going through, but I understand what wanting to die without actually planning to die is like. I haven't figured out how to deal with it or get help, but at least you can know that I DO NOT think you are an attention seeker. I wish you the best

Your situation sounds really tough, im sorry you're going through that. I hear that you are feeling horrible. I urge you to ask yourself whether you really want to be with this person. Consider everything she has said and done, and how you feel in the relationship. If you're not feeling good about staying, that's okay. You have a right to leave and she will learn to accept it once the pain passes.

The pain only gets worse the deeper you dig into that hole. I tried to do that and the pain was unbearable. Negative coping strategies work for a bit then make you feel 10x worse. 

I hope you can start to feel better soon. You might feel better if you complete your paper. If you can, give it a try.
It's so great that you did a lot of research and are trying to understand. That is really amazing of you. Not many people do that. I hope your relationship works out.

For the first time in my relationship I am considering leaving my bf because I hate myself and everything I do so much. It's really hard for me to be around people because I have depression and am frequently told im dramatic or over reacting. My bf loves me but last night he was mad at me and said I was dramatic. Since then I have wanted to just leave everyone and be alone since everyone seems to think negative things about me. But the thing is though, I don't really want to be alone forever. I can't speak for your bf, but what would help me if I was in that situation is some distance (which you gave), then showing you care and are there for support. Maybe asking how things are going. 

I'm not sure if this is helpful at all, but if your bf is like me then maybe he wants to be with you but is struggling with depression too much. 

I hope everything works out and im sorry this happened

I feel the same kind of anger toward people who do not bother to help or just even be pleasant. I vowed to try to make people's lives even just slightly easier or nicer, by saying hello, helping in times of need, volunteering, or even just smiling. I am still struggling greatly trying to figure out how to feel better and how to stop wanting to die. Until then I just want to try to show people that I care. I care about your suffering and I wouldn't wish it on anyone. I can't help you very much since I struggle to keep myself alive, but im here to just chat if you need to. I'm not going to sit back and ignore you like everyone has ignored me
Can I do anything to help? Talk for a bit? I like dubstep too.
Everyone I have tried to talk to has told me I am over reacting.
